en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a bustling outdoor market on a cobblestone square. Numerous horse-drawn carts or wooden wagons are lined up, each loaded with large sacks, likely of flour or grain. Men and women in traditional early 20th‑century clothing stand around the carts, engaged in trade. In the background is a long, two‑ to three‑story masonry building with a metal roof and regularly spaced windows, and a row of leafy trees in front of it. The card shows signs of age and creasing. Russian text is printed in the lower left corner.
